answer: We define a protocol where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds require staking capital that creates a basalt barrier against identity proliferation by enforcing linear scaling of slashing penalties. Within this cryptographic lagoon, subgame-perfect punishment matrices ensure that any attempt to flood the network yields negative utility, as the validator marginal cost exceeds the expected river of recursive rewards. Consequently, the system converges to a unique Nash equilibrium where honest staking remains the only viable strategy.
